notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated reserved pool for latency-sensitive driver-assist + high-throughput reranking. Scope: 8-GPU sizing recommendation but started with 4-GPU test cluster. Requirements:
- Latency SLO: p95 < 120ms for driver-assist (context <= 512 tokens), p99 < 300ms acceptable for non-critical reranks.
- Throughput: sustain 250 requests/sec mixed workload (60% rerank, 30% embeddings, 10% chat) with <10% queuing overhead.
- Cost sensitivity: want to keep ARR within $250k-$750k band; strong interest in Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
- Security: VPC-only egress, enterprise KMS, SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 13 months, EU data residency for EU drivers.

POC plan executed so far:
- Load tests: synthetic traffic shaped by Skyhook trace histograms (burst profile: 30s spikes every 5m). Peak QPS target: 320.
- Soak tests: two runs — 24h on 4 GPUs, 72h planned on 8 GPUs after PO. Observations: KV cache warmup reduces token cost by ~18% after 30 minutes; early tail latencies correlated with cache cold starts and small batching window config.
- Representative prompts used in tests:
  * Driver assist: short-context commands + telemetry (20-200 tokens) — prioritizes p95 latency.
  * Route reranking: long documents embeddings + top-K reranking calls (300-600 tokens) — throughput heavy.
  * Incident summarization: multi-turn context (1k tokens) used for evening batch job.

Preliminary metrics (4-GPU run):
- Sustained mixed throughput: 210 req/s median, peaks 310 req/s for <10s windows.
- p50/p95/p99 (driver-assist): 38ms / 115ms / 280ms.
- Token cost per 1k generated: ~ $0.027 with current quantization/FP16 path.
- Observed queuing under synthetic bursts: 12% requests experienced >50ms queueing.

SLA & procurement notes:
- Skyhook legal wants 99.95% monthly uptime and defined credit matrix for latency SLO misses (esp p95/p99). Seeking clarification on how Redwood measures service time for credit calculations.
- Request for explicit throughput guarantee per reserved GPU and clear fallback model mapping when capacity hits (e.g., full pool saturated -> degrade non-critical rerank to smaller model).
- Procurement asking for a 6-month trial with ramp clauses before annual commit.

Technical next steps / open action items:
- Redwood SE to provide detailed 8-GPU throughput projection and expected p95 under target workload (package by 2026-03-15).
- Infra team to approve KMS cross-account flow; legal to sign MSA redlines.
- Schedule full 72h soak on 8-GPU reserved pool once PO signed; include chaos test (node preemption) to validate graceful degradation policies.
- Provide an Optimize runbook with recommended batching windows, cache TTL, and quantization profile to meet ARR constraints.
